scope: Independent ACT1 native contract review. No game control, process access, save reads, source edits, or writes to previously frozen evidence. Native ranges use end-exclusive addresses.

type1.field: Native DWORD checker+0x68; the API projects the raw bits as int32. The exclusion predicate is !=0, identical for signed/unsigned interpretations. It is a priority value, not a reference count. Same original source binding and table/getter checks as type0; repeat the level with actor/user/UID/checker identity.
type1.early_lock_predicate: 8BA7F0: command DWORD+0 is type. For type1, checker+0x68 != 0 sets command byte+8 to 1 and returns false before physical button reads.
type1.remaining_physical_branch: After a zero lock, checker byte+0x90 must be zero. command DWORD+4 == 0 reads byte CFD200; every nonzero code reads CFD202. If the selected button is false, clear command byte+8 and return false. If true, a nonzero prior command byte+8 suppresses AL; otherwise return AL=1.
type1.scope_limit: This is the early physical check, not a promise that all command events are suppressed. Town ground-click processing uses CFD200/202 and its own panel/capture/hit/world gates rather than this type1 check.
type1.outer_exception: 8BAAD0 calls v+30=8BA7F0. When that returns false, if checker+0x6C == 0 and the linked list at checker+0x78 contains this command ID, 8BABBF forces AL=1 before event generation. Do not infer complete command admission or world/global input from the lock alone.
type1.priority: 8BA030 uses unsigned maximum priority when acquiring and clears only when stored level <= release level. It is not a reference count.
type1.flag90: One byte. 8BA9A4 initializes zero. 48F81E and 48F844 set one on an original 43BB30 checker installed into actor+2384 through v+5E4=493B50. Its owner/reason remains opaque. At the physical checker only, the unconditional exclusion predicate is lock1 != 0 OR flag90 != 0. Read/repeat it as an optional raw flag, not a global blocker.

CFD208.width: One byte; native writes are 7993C4 -> 1 and 8FCC9D -> 0. The only absolute native reads found are 8FCAE8 and 8FCB7D. Native branch tests use !=0.
CFD208.scope: Engine mouse button-state processing suspension/defer flag. It does not clear existing held-button state.
CFD208.direct_input: When byte CFD20A == 1, 8FCAA0 first updates coordinates using device CFD20C +20/+24 and offsets CFD210/214. CFD208 !=0 skips updates to CFD200..203 and CFD1F4/F8. This branch does not enqueue button events.
CFD208.window_messages: When CFD20A !=1, coordinates are still updated from signed lParam XY plus offsets. CFD208 !=0 enqueues message ID only. With zero flag, WM201/202/204/205 update button state; WM203 and unrelated messages do not.
CFD208.callback: Both branches reach 8FCC45. If CFD204 is nonnull its v0 callback(msg,wParam,lParam) still executes at 8FCC57.
CFD208.release: 8FCC80 clears CFD208 first, drains the message-ID queue through 8FCAA0(msg,0,0), then restores cursor/coordinates. This is not a guarantee that DirectInput clicks were queued or will replay.
CFD208.safe_capture: Read unsigned byte twice under the existing image/scene snapshot identity guard. Require both <=1 and equal; otherwise publish unknown. Do not call the original mouse handler/release/callback and do not walk or consume the native queue.
not_implied: A waiting reason inferred from dialog count

Active registration, pending close, and attached layer order are separate observations. These three focus paths set/release type0 priority1; no inference of type1 locking from their existence.
